topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously introduced immune components fit together.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects microbes and cellular damage using germline-encoded pattern recognition receptors and downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory cell activation, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells orchestrate leukocyte trafficking, lymphatic migration, and the systemic consequences of acute inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how acute inflammation is terminated, how damaged tissue is repaired, and how the body manages persistent inflammatory stimuli.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the complement system.
